notes: Inbound via self-serve sign-up. Small startup building an in-app support assistant. Using hosted_api streaming + function-calling to create tickets in their internal system. Observed: when using JSON/structured output mode with streaming enabled, client-side parsers get incomplete/invalid JSON on ~0.5-2% of sessions. They reported two failure modes: (1) 'function_call' tokens arrive across stream boundaries causing parser error mid-object; (2) strict schema validation rejects valid variant responses when fields arrive reordered during streaming. CTO: "We need predictable JSON — can't ship parser that fails on 1% of agent responses." They tried wrapping responses with fences, buffering until stream end, and switching to non-streaming (works but adds latency). POC goal: keep streaming for latency but make structured output deterministic. SMEs: SE will attempt to reproduce with their minimal example and an attached postman/JS client. Their priority is low cost + low latency; will likely accept hosted_api with guidance rather than Dedicated at this stage.
